mapper.select: SELECT r.side, r.speaker_client_id, r.speaker_name, m.content FROM ai_debate_record r LEFT JOIN ai_chat_room_message m ON r.message_id = m.message_id WHERE r.session_id = #{sessionId} AND r.round_number = #{roundNumber} ORDER BY r.turn_number ASC

SELECT record_id, session_id, round_number, turn_number, speaker_client_id, side, message_id, arbitrator_reasoning, create_time FROM ai_debate_record WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND round_number = #{roundNumber} ORDER BY turn_number ASC

SELECT record_id, session_id, round_number, turn_number, speaker_client_id, side, message_id, arbitrator_reasoning, create_time FROM ai_debate_record WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY round_number ASC, turn_number ASC
